text:
چڑھیا باون بیر
گھٹن مجھیاں گائیاں دے کھیر
نالے کھٹن ندیاں دے نیر۔
romanized:
Charhea Bawan bir
Ghattan majjhia gaia dé khir
Nalé khuttan nadia de nir.
literal_en: When the constellation Bawan bir has risen (in the end of September) the milk of buffaloes and cows diminishes, and the water of rivers dries up.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
